business.name: Strategic Sloth
business.type: Founder-led studio: game UI and UX, apps, websites, training products, and a 24/7 auto-reply service for local businesses
business.address: Montreal, Quebec. Working worldwide, in person or remote, including Playa del Carmen and the Riviera Maya.
business.owner: Guillaume "Remi" Couture, founder. He leads every project and sets up every assistant himself.

answers.autoreplyWhat: The 24/7 auto-reply answers a business's customers in seconds, day and night, using only information the owner approves, and passes anything tricky to a real person. In Mexico it runs on WhatsApp in Spanish and English. In the United States and Canada it leads with text messages (missed-call text-back) and Messenger, plus Instagram and WhatsApp: English and Spanish in the US, English and French in Canada, French first in Quebec. Setup is live within 3 business days after the owner connects the accounts and approves the answers; Meta's business verification, and in the US business texting registration, can add time.
answers.autoreplyHowToStart: Pick a plan and pay online at https://strategicsloth.com/us/whatsapp-autoreply/ (United States, US dollars), https://strategicsloth.com/ca/whatsapp-autoreply/ (Canada, English, Canadian dollars), https://strategicsloth.com/fr/whatsapp-autoreply/ (Quebec, French, Canadian dollars), https://strategicsloth.com/es/whatsapp-autoreply/ (Mexico, Spanish, pesos) or https://strategicsloth.com/whatsapp-autoreply/ (Mexico, English, pesos). Then fill in the setup form from the payment email: about 15 minutes from a phone.
answers.autoreplyPlans: Three plans in every country. First plan (Básico in Mexico, Essential in the US, Essentiel in Canada): instant answers from the approved FAQ, after-hours reply, lead capture to a Google Sheet with an owner alert, handoff to a person, 30 minutes of updates a month. Second plan, the most popular (Reservas, Bookings, Réservations): everything in the first plan plus booking or hold requests that staff confirm, reminders and confirmations, a monthly report and 1 hour of updates a month; in Mexico it adds Instagram DM, in the US and Canada it adds Messenger, Instagram, WhatsApp and missed-call text-back. Third plan (Completo, Complete, Complet): everything in the second plan plus up to 2 numbers, next-day follow-up, review requests, a monthly review call and 2 hours of updates a month (in Mexico also missed-call text-back).
answers.autoreplyExtraCosts: The business owns its accounts and pays providers directly. WhatsApp: Meta's message fees; Meta gives each business number 1,000 free service messages a month. Missed-call texts in the US and Canada use a Twilio number in the business's name, paid directly to Twilio; in the US, carriers also require business texting to be registered (A2P 10DLC), which has its own fees. If a chatbot platform is needed, that subscription is paid directly too.
answers.autoreplyTerms: Monthly care can be cancelled any time with 30 days' notice by email. Once setup starts, 50% of the setup fee is not refundable. The business owns its accounts.
answers.studioPackages: Studio packages in US dollars: Screen review $490 (48 hours). UI & UX audit $2,900 (about 1 week). Game UI vertical slice from $9,800 (2 to 4 weeks). Game UI system from $24,000 (6 to 10 weeks). Embedded UI partner $6,500 per month. Website from $7,500 (3 to 4 weeks). App MVP from $24,000 (6 to 10 weeks). Mobile game prototype from $15,000 (4 to 6 weeks). Game from prototype to store launch from $45,000. Training and simulation pilot from $8,000. Senior day rate $850 per day for work outside a package.
answers.localBusiness: Custom websites and apps for local businesses: restaurants, shops, tour operators, clinics, gyms and hotels. Mobile-friendly, fast and ready for Google, in English, Spanish or French. The quote is free and every project has a fixed price agreed in writing before work starts. Files, accounts and code belong to the client at handover.
answers.studioWhat: Strategic Sloth designs and builds game UI and UX, web and desktop apps, websites and training products, working in Unreal Engine, Unity, Godot, PlayCanvas and the web. It can design, implement, or both, inside the client's repository and pipeline.
answers.howToBook: To start a studio project or ask for a quote, use the contact form at https://strategicsloth.com/contact/ and Remi replies in person, usually within one business day. For the auto-reply, pick a plan on the offer page. You can also message on WhatsApp and a person will reply.
answers.location: Based in Montreal. Works remotely worldwide, and in person in Playa del Carmen and the Riviera Maya for local businesses.

booking.rules: Calls and projects are not booked in chat. Collect the person's name, business, what they need and their timing, and say Remi will reply to set it up.
